_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Resource notices drop a notice whose kind a reconnect no longer reports. The page's live stream (/api/stream2) reports low disk space and high memory pressure; each connection ends at once and the page reconnects about a second later. Call "drop memory" makes later connections report only the low disk space, as a restarted server whose memory monitor could not start would. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /. 2. The element with data-testid "memory-notice" should be visible (allow 30s). 3. Call "drop memory". 4. There should then be exactly 0 elements with data-testid "memory-notice" (allow 30s). 5. The element with data-testid "disk-notice" should be visible.
